purpose: Compare nonlinear and reduced models without selecting on reused 2025/2026 outcomes
selection: Lowest pooled out-of-time Brier score over 2022 and 2023
limitations: 2024 was used in v1 selection; 2025 and 2026 have already been seen. All replay comparisons are retrospective, not new independent validation. No automated replacement of v1.
fixed_hyperparameters: Logistic C=0.01; spline 4 quantile knots degree 2, C=0.01; boosting 150 iterations, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=7, min_samples_leaf=100, l2_regularization=10, early_stopping=false; no class balancing
